# A struct, a list and a map are values: storing one -- a push, an
# assignment, a local, a literal's element, a map's entry -- stores a copy, so
# a later write to either place leaves the other as it was. An element bound
# with `&` is written in place and copied where it is stored elsewhere. Go
# shares a slice's storage and JavaScript and Kotlin every object, so each
# language writes the copy out from the value's type; the interpreter copies
# at the store. A parameter is passed by value: a function that modifies one
# takes its own copy, and one that only reads it copies nothing.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '8 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Row {
    n     int = 0
    items list[int] = []
}

struct Tree {
    label string
    kids  list[Tree] = []
}

func bumped(r Row) int {
    r.n = 5
    r.items.push(1)
    return r.n
}

func Row.grow(r Row) {
    r.n += 1
}

func size(r Row) int {
    return r.n + r.items.length()
}

func replaced(r Row) int {
    r = Row{n=9}
    return r.n
}

func pushedTo(xs list[int]) int {
    xs.push(3)
    return xs.length()
}

component box ui.node {
    var (
        xs list[Row] = [Row{n=1, items=[1]}]
        ys list[Row] = []
        a list[int] = [1, 2]
        b list[int] = []
        p = Row{n=1, items=[1]}
        q = Row{}
        t = Tree{label="a", kids=[Tree{label="b"}]}
        u = Tree{label="x"}
        m map[string, Row] = {"a"=Row{n=1}}
        mm map[string, Row] = {"b"=Row{}}
        out = ""
    )

    func pushed() {
        ys.push(xs[0])
        xs[0].n = 5
        xs[0].items.push(2)
        out = "{ys[0].n} {ys[0].items.length()}"
    }

    func assigned() {
        q = p
        b = a
        p.items[0] = 9
        a[0] = 9
        out = "{q.items[0]} {b[0]}"
    }

    func local() {
        var l = xs[0]
        xs[0].n = 7
        l.items.push(4)
        out = "{l.n} {xs[0].items.length()}"
    }

    func literal() {
        ys = [p]
        p.n = 4
        out = "{ys[0].n}"
    }

    func referenced() {
        for var &x = xs {
            ys.push(x)
            x.n = 9
        }
        out = "{ys[0].n} {xs[0].n}"
    }

    func tree() {
        u = t
        t.kids.push(Tree{label="c"})
        out = "{u.kids.length()} {t.kids.length()}"
    }

    func maps() {
        mm = m
        m["a"] = Row{n=7}
        out = "{mm.get("a", Row{}).n}"
    }

    func params() {
        var bv = bumped(p)
        p.grow()
        var sv = size(p)
        var rv = replaced(p)
        var lv = pushedTo(a)
        out = "{p.n} {p.items.length()} {bv} {sv} {rv} {lv} {a.length()}"
    }

    ui.text #o(value=out)
}

func testPushedElementIsACopy(t Test, c box) {
    c.pushed()
    t.assert(c.o.value == "1 1")
}

func testAssignmentCopies(t Test, c box) {
    c.assigned()
    t.assert(c.o.value == "1 1")
}

func testLocalIsACopy(t Test, c box) {
    c.local()
    t.assert(c.o.value == "1 1")
}

func testLiteralElementIsACopy(t Test, c box) {
    c.literal()
    t.assert(c.o.value == "1")
}

func testReferencedElementStoredIsACopy(t Test, c box) {
    c.referenced()
    t.assert(c.o.value == "1 9")
}

func testRecursiveStructCopies(t Test, c box) {
    c.tree()
    t.assert(c.o.value == "1 2")
}

func testMapCopies(t Test, c box) {
    c.maps()
    t.assert(c.o.value == "1")
}

func testParametersArePassedByValue(t Test, c box) {
    c.params()
    t.assert(c.o.value == "1 1 5 2 9 3 2")
}

ui.window {
    box
}
